findings.issue: Bronze is attached as a genitive of the bases and the ל-phrase follows; the tokens juxtapose the bases, then for the columns, then bronze.
findings.spanishSpan: las basas de bronce, a las columnas

findings.issue: The construct is overlay of their heads, then silver; Spanish places silver between chapado and sus cabezas.
findings.spanishSpan: chapado de plata de sus cabezas

notes: All sixteen tokens are present; number, person, and the passive Pual participle are preserved.
